description: A squad patrols across ambush country to seize OBJ ALPHA; a BRIQUE armed band (manual p. 9) is posted in ambush on the route, with mines laid.
opord: SL1, THIS IS HQ: OPORD — SEIZE OBJ ALPHA. OUT.
